hero.h1: The US–Nepal corridor, in one room.
hero.lede: An invite-only network for the operators, investors, and professionals moving capital, projects, and people between the United States and Nepal. Everyone here is verified before they're let in.

culture.h2: Trust in this corridor is generational.
culture.body: Reputation here is kept the old way — in person, over decades, across families and firms. Sangamline verifies the people who actually show up: real names, real entities, standing earned on the ground.

bridge.h2: Distance is not the hard part. Trust is.
bridge.body: Work across this corridor stalls on the same question: you can find someone, but you can't tell whether they're real. Sangamline starts on the other side of that question — both parties checked, both parties at the same table.

verification.h2: Three checks stand behind every profile.
verification.body: No member counts, no logo walls. The restraint is the claim. A person reviews every application, on both sides of the corridor, before anyone appears in the directory.
verification.recheckedValue: Annually, and on change of role
verification.check1Body: Government ID matched to a live face check, once, by a reviewer. Names are compared against the entity you claim to represent.
verification.check1Meta: PASSPORT OR NATIONAL ID · SELFIE MATCH
verification.check2Body: Company registration, mandate letter, or employment confirmed on the side you operate from — Kathmandu or a US state register.
verification.check2Meta: OCR / PAN / VAT · SECRETARY OF STATE · LETTERHEAD
verification.check3Body: What you actually do is stated on your profile, in the open, where members can hold you to it. Change what you do and the tag changes with a note.
verification.check3Meta: ONE PRIMARY SECTOR · UP TO TWO SECONDARY
verification.notBody: Verification is not an endorsement, a credit check, or a guarantee of outcomes. It says this person is who they say they are. What they build with that is between members.

roster.h2: For the people doing the moving.
roster.r1Body: You're running something on the ground and you need counterparts who won't cost you a quarter.
roster.r2Body: You want deal flow you can diligence, not introductions you have to untangle.
roster.r3Body: You left, you're building, and you want a way back in that isn't a Facebook group.
roster.r4Body: You're selling Nepal to the world and you need partners who show up in season.
roster.r5Body: You move freight through ports, airports, and customs regimes where experience is the only shortcut.
roster.r6Body: You place students, nurses, and engineers — and you need pipelines that survive a visa cycle.
roster.r7Body: You work the rules on both sides — treaties, taxes, registration, compliance — and precision is the product.
roster.bannerRight: TOURISM IS A SUPPLY CHAIN. IT NEEDS OPERATORS.

cta.h2: Membership is by invitation. Ask for one.
cta.body: Leave your email and we'll open the conversation. Tell us what you move and where — a person reads every request, and everyone gets an answer.

footer.tagline: An invite-only professional network for the US–Nepal corridor. Every member verified before entry.

tour.s1Title: One room for the whole corridor.
tour.s1Lede: Sangamline is an invite-only network for people doing real work between the United States and Nepal — operators, investors, diaspora professionals, and tourism leaders.
tour.s1P1: A member directory you can actually trust, organized by sector and side of the corridor.
tour.s1P2: Events, trips, and working conversations — not a feed of announcements.
tour.s1P3: Built for people who move capital, projects, and people. Not an audience.
tour.s2Lede: Bridge Verified means a person confirmed who you are before you entered the room. That's the entire premise — and it applies to everyone equally.
tour.s2P1: Identity checked — a real person, under their real name.
tour.s2P2: Entity or role confirmed — the company, fund, or position is what it says.
tour.s2P3: Sector tagged, publicly — so counterparts know what you actually do.
tour.s3Lede: Create an account and you can browse the room right away. Verifying your profile is what unlocks posting and messaging — that's where the invite-only standard is enforced.
tour.s3P1: Create your account — email or Google, in English or नेपाली.
tour.s3P2: Set up your profile — sector, side of the corridor, what you move.
tour.s3P3: Request verification; review usually completes within a few days.

guidelines.lede: The same guidelines every member agrees to when they join the app.
guidelines.rule1: Be specific. Real asks and real offers — this is a working room, not a broadcast channel.
guidelines.rule2: Vouch carefully. Every business you add to your team reflects on you as the owner.
guidelines.rule3: Keep deals honest. Misrepresenting a business or listing gets one warning, then removal.
guidelines.rule4: Respect both sides of the corridor. Two countries, one community.
guidelines.dataH1: What we hold, and what you can take with you.
guidelines.data1: Verification documents are held encrypted and never published — only the verification outcome appears on your profile.
guidelines.data2: Your data is processed in the United States, as stated at signup.
guidelines.data3: From Settings → Data & Legal in the app you can download everything as JSON, or delete your account entirely.
